title: Arcsine power series and derivative
statement: For each integer $j\ge 0$, let $c_j=\binom{2j}{j}/(2^{2j}(2j+1))$. If $z\in\mathbb R$ satisfies $|z|<1$, then the series $\sum_{j=0}^{\infty}c_jz^{2j+1}$ converges, and the function $y\mapsto\sum_{j=0}^{\infty}c_jy^{2j+1}$ is differentiable at $z$ with derivative $(1-z^2)^{-1/2}$.
